All migrations properly construct and reuse the newly introduced `DenseSession`. A guard in `qa_dense_generate` strictly enforces that GPU gates refuse turns with `used_gpu=false` (GPU fallback), as required by the ticket. Finally, both requested witnesses are included and structured accurately. The changes successfully accomplish the ticket without violating any constraints.
